trigger: Shown via Survey Devotion and on posture transitions.

trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.

trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.

trigger: Passive blessing description; visible whenever the player views active effects.
draft_prose: Mephala draws the web close. Poison resistance +20%; the hidden network returns 5% more gold. Discretion opens doors others never see.

deity_tone: Azura: Twilight-voiced, prophetic, tender about painful truth; speaks of thresholds and of becoming truer, not merely stronger; warns rather than commands.
trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first Azura Devoted.
draft_prose: Title: "Azura at the Threshold" Body: "I marked your people once, at the worst crossing they ever made. I mark you now. Stand at the thresholds, and you will not stand at them blind."

deity_tone: Azura: Twilight-voiced, prophetic, tender about painful truth; speaks of thresholds and of becoming truer, not merely stronger; warns rather than commands.
trigger: HUD corner notification. Azura Devoted + threshold beat; one per in-game day.
draft_prose: At the threshold, Azura's voice goes ahead of you.

deity_tone: Boethiah: Trial-voiced, sharp, strength-testing; speaks of the unworthy cut away and the self authored through struggle; combative, never cruel.
trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first Boethiah Devoted.
draft_prose: Title: "Boethiah's Mark" Body: "You did not survive. You overcame. The unworthy fell, and you stood where they stood. Author yourself further -- I am watching, and so are the dead."

deity_tone: Boethiah: Trial-voiced, sharp, strength-testing; speaks of the unworthy cut away and the self authored through struggle; combative, never cruel.
trigger: HUD corner notification. Boethiah Devoted + rival-strength kill; cooldown.
draft_prose: A worthy foe down. The ancestors have seen.

deity_tone: Mephala: Soft, conspiratorial, web-voiced; speaks of the hidden people, the secret kept, the web drawn close; intimate rather than loud.
trigger: MessageBox. One-time on first Mephala Devoted.
draft_prose: Title: "Mephala's Web" Body: "The hidden people survive because someone holds the threads. You hold them now. The web knows your hand, and it will not let you fall through it."

deity_tone: Mephala: Soft, conspiratorial, web-voiced; speaks of the hidden people, the secret kept, the web drawn close; intimate rather than loud.
trigger: HUD corner notification. Mephala Devoted + hidden-community beat; per qualifying event.
draft_prose: The web tightens, quietly, in your favor.

deity_tone: Azura: Twilight-voiced, prophetic, tender about painful truth; speaks of thresholds and of becoming truer, not merely stronger; warns rather than commands.
trigger: MessageBox. Dawn-fire; per-deity cooldown.
draft_prose: Title: "Azura's Twilight" Body: "You have lived toward me without naming it -- the thresholds kept, the hard truths faced. This is not leaving the ancestors. It is the ash-prayer deepening toward dawn. Will you name me your focus?"

deity_tone: Boethiah: Trial-voiced, sharp, strength-testing; speaks of the unworthy cut away and the self authored through struggle; combative, never cruel.
trigger: MessageBox. Dawn-fire; per-deity cooldown.
draft_prose: Title: "Boethiah's Trial" Body: "You have proven yourself against the unworthy again and again. The ancestors witnessed it; now I ask for it by name. This deepens the Reclamation; it does not replace the ash. Will you name me your focus?"

deity_tone: Mephala: Soft, conspiratorial, web-voiced; speaks of the hidden people, the secret kept, the web drawn close; intimate rather than loud.
trigger: MessageBox. Dawn-fire; per-deity cooldown.
draft_prose: Title: "Mephala's Whisper" Body: "You have kept the web whole without being asked. The hidden people are safer for you. Name me your focus, and the ash-prayer deepens into the web -- nothing of the ancestors is set down. Will you?"

trigger: MessageBox. Marked only when the truth costs safety, power, or belonging.
draft_prose: Title: "Azura's Star" Body: "The truth cost you safety, and you took it anyway. That is the becoming I watch for. Walk on, clearer than you were."

trigger: HUD corner notification. After-act/environmental; continuity across distance.
draft_prose: Far from home, the practice held. Exile did not dissolve you.

trigger: MessageBox. Rare major; curse-state confrontation or major cleansing only.
draft_prose: Title: "Azura Knows" Body: "Your body has changed, and I did not look away. What you are now is not simple, and I will not pretend it is. But you are still becoming, and I am still here."

trigger: HUD corner notification. Environmental/after-act; shrine and artifact signals.
draft_prose: The Star and the twilight answer you personally now.

draft_prose: Title: "Boethiah's Calling" Body: "You cut away an order that did not deserve to stand. This is the trial: not destruction, but the worthier thing put in its place. Stand there."

trigger: HUD corner notification. After-act; for surviving the test, never casual cruelty.
draft_prose: Betrayed, and you answered with strength. The test is passed.

trigger: HUD corner notification. After-act; keeping the hidden people intact, not generic charity.

draft_prose: A secret held, and an obligation with it. The web holds.

trigger: MessageBox. Marked only for major Mephala quest/artifact moments.
draft_prose: Title: "The Whispering Door" Body: "A blade in the dark, drawn for the web and not for yourself. The hidden people will never know it was you. I will."

draft_prose: Title: "The Ash-Prayer Silenced" Body: "You set the ash and speak the prayer, and for the first time in your life nothing answers. The ancestors do not speak to the undead. The silence is total, and it is yours now."

trigger: MessageBox. Once on cure; sets posture RestoredScarred.
draft_prose: Title: "The Ancestors Answer" Body: "The ash-prayer carries again. We hear you. But we heard the silence too, and it does not leave us, or you. Return -- scarred, and still ours."

trigger: MessageBox. Once on first transformation; sets posture Strained.
draft_prose: Title: "Ritually Unclean" Body: "The beast in you has no place in the ash or the Reclamations. The ancestors do not turn away, but they answer thinly now. Hircine offers nothing to fill the gap."

draft_prose: "I carry the ash-prayer in exile, as you do. Tell me what the quarter needs."

draft_prose: "The Good Daedra answer me. Speak of the Reclamations."
